title: Week1
scope_summary: This document is a default GitLab project README template with starter onboarding guidance. It covers repository setup, adding files, collaboration workflows, integrations, and CI/CD deployment pointers. The latter half provides generic instructions for customizing a project README rather than defining product requirements or architecture decisions.
key_decisions_or_requirements: Initialize and push project files to the configured GitLab remote repository.
Set up project integrations, team collaboration settings, and merge request workflow.
Adopt GitLab CI/CD and related deployment/security features as part of project setup.
Replace template content with project-specific README documentation.
